title: List Operations - Sort and Remove
description: Use Sort List and Remove Values From List to manipulate list contents.

theory.title: Exercise 4.1.2: List Manipulation
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Data rarely comes in the format we need. Logs are unsorted, duplicates appear, items need removal. Collections library gives us the tools to reshape data."

List Modification Keywords

Sort List - Sorts list in-place:

@{items}=    Create List    C    A    B
Sort List    ${items}
# Now: [A, B, C]

Remove Values From List - Removes all occurrences:

@{nums}=    Create List    1    2    3    2    4
Remove Values From List    ${nums}    2
# Now: [1, 3, 4]

Other Useful Keywords:

  • Reverse List: Reverse order
  • Remove Duplicates: Keep unique values only
  • Insert Into List: Add at specific index
  • Remove From List: Remove by index

Example: Data Cleaning Pipeline

*** Settings ***
Library    Collections

*** Test Cases ***
Clean Sensor Data
    @{readings}=    Create List    23.5    19.2    23.5    ERROR    21.0
    Remove Values From List    ${readings}    ERROR
    Sort List    ${readings}
    Log    Clean sorted data: ${readings}

⚠️ List Operation Tips

  • Sort List modifies original list (in-place)
  • Sorting is alphabetical by default, numeric with numbers
  • Remove Values From List removes ALL matches
  • Use Remove From List to remove by position/index
  • These operations are destructive (change original list)
